description: This is a Java test class for the PrefItem class, testing its properties, validation, and hierarchy handling in the preferences backup module of the project.

classes.name: PrefItemTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the PrefItem class functionality, including validation and hierarchy management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new PrefItem instance before each test.

methods.name: testFailsIfKeyIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that adding a value with an empty key throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testFailsIfKeyHasNonAsciiLetterCharacters
methods.description: Tests that adding a value with a key containing non-ASCII characters throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testFailsIfKeyHasSpaces
methods.description: Tests that adding a value with a key containing spaces throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testFailsIfKeyStartsWithDigit
methods.description: Tests that adding a value with a key starting with a digit throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testProperties
methods.description: Tests the creation of nested PrefItems, adding values, and retrieving them to verify hierarchy and value overriding.
